note: Background groups for games (clouds, landscapes, paintings) and the sprite lexicon. Each group lists sources tried in order and mixed round-robin: commons = a CirrusSearch query on Wikimedia Commons ('in': fp = Featured pictures, qi = Quality images, or category names joined by |; 'not': words to exclude; sort defaults to random), aic = Art Institute of Chicago artist names (match_phrase on artist_title) and/or 'words' (title + terms), 'type' 1 = Painting, 'types' = artwork_type_title values kept; cma = Cleveland Museum of Art query ('type' must be an exact CMA type such as Painting or Print); met = The Met search ('artist' searches artist/culture, 'dept' = departmentId, 'n' = objects fetched). Group 'reject' is a regex tested on titles and Commons categories.

sprites.note: Sprite tags come from the file title, the search that found it and any categories. 'groups' maps words (singular; phrases allowed) to a coarse group; ties go to the earlier group in 'order'. 'extra' adds one transparent PNG per made-up product object (and per extra query) so products can find pictures that suit their names.
